comparison.objective: Push a spacer through a covered channel, recover it, and park the pusher; candidate calibrates sensor locations.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-tool alignment and causal pushing followed by pick-and-place versus partial fastener release and precise slide-and-lock adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Verified ≥40 mm pusher-driven exit, nested spacer, parked tool, and 1 s release; candidate requires two valid sensor endpoints held 3 s.
comparison.reason: The record does not test sensing-based registration or fastening without drift. Candidate lacks numeric drift and fastener-force thresholds.
